verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an email SaaS, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence documents a Superhuman command-line tool. The official MCP server is a different integration surface. The Cmd+K command palette and a user's mention of a 'command-line approach' describe in-app keyboard UI, not a CLI, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
